caption:
FHA loans are getting new score options. 🏠

Starting January 1, 2027, VantageScore 4.0 and FICO 10T become eligible for FHA-insured mortgages, alongside the traditional FICO.

Nothing changes today, and every lender sets its own rules.

Would you want to know which score your lender pulls?
first_comment: Did you know your lender might use a different score than the one in your app? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Which score do you check most? Tell us at @creditscoretruths 👇
